entry.title: Progressive Distillation for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
entry.summary: We distill diffusion samplers into four-step generators, reporting an eight times speedup with small FID loss on ImageNet.

entry.title: Consistency Models for One-Step Image Generation
entry.summary: We introduce consistency models that map noise directly to data, enabling one-step generation and reporting the largest speedup among distillation baselines.

entry.title: Adversarial Diffusion Distillation
entry.summary: We combine score distillation with an adversarial loss to produce high-fidelity images in one to four sampling steps.

entry.title: Guidance Distillation for Classifier-Free Diffusion
entry.summary: We distill classifier-free guidance into a single network, halving the cost of each sampling step at similar quality.

entry.title: A Survey of Few-Step Diffusion Sampling
entry.summary: We survey solvers and distillation techniques for accelerating diffusion sampling and discuss open evaluation problems.

entry.title: Basalt Columns as a Metaphor for Step Reduction in Samplers
entry.summary: We study how stacked sampler stages behave like basalt columns and report a modest gain in sample diversity on CIFAR-10.

entry.title: Cobalt: Low-Rank Adapters for Distilled Image Generators
entry.summary: We attach low-rank adapters to distilled generators and recover most of the lost detail with under two percent extra parameters.

entry.title: Quartz Schedules for Few-Step Noise Scheduling
entry.summary: We propose fixed noise schedules tuned for four-step sampling and compare them against cosine and linear baselines.

entry.title: Granite Benchmarks for Diffusion Sampler Evaluation
entry.summary: We release a benchmark suite measuring sampler speed, memory use and fidelity across five datasets.

entry.title: Obsidian Latents: Sharper Reconstructions from Compact Codes
entry.summary: We train compact latent codes that reconstruct fine texture, reporting improved sharpness over a standard autoencoder.

entry.title: Feldspar Teachers for Student Sampler Training
entry.summary: We select teacher checkpoints by validation loss and show that student samplers train faster with the selected teachers.

entry.title: Gypsum Pruning of Attention Layers in Image Generators
entry.summary: We prune attention heads from pretrained generators and measure the quality drop at several sparsity levels.

entry.title: Marble Textures: Controllable Style Transfer with Few Steps
entry.summary: We add a style conditioning branch to a fast sampler and evaluate user preference on a small panel of raters.

entry.title: Dolomite Caching for Repeated Denoising Calls
entry.summary: We cache intermediate activations across denoising calls and report a thirty percent latency reduction without retraining.

entry.title: Pumice Quantization of Generator Weights
entry.summary: We quantize generator weights to four bits with a calibration set and describe the failure cases we observed.
